name: Olimpbet
verdict: Russian bookmaker; its operator BK Olimp is 97.5% owned by Zevs LLC, a Moscow company belonging to private individuals Andrey Petukhov and Darina Denisova. Nothing found.
note: Betting brand; official partner of several KHL clubs (CSKA, Dynamo, Spartak, Severstal, Amur, Admiral, Neftekhimik, Sochi, SKA) and title partner of the MHL and VHL. On Neftekhimik's shirt shoulders under a three-year deal announced September 2025. Ownership traced to private individuals, no state body or fund in the chain; no court, regulator, UN-body or major-NGO human-rights finding against the company found (searched 3 Oct 2026).
